in_marathi.name: Debarati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's beloved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debarati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Debarati is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Deba’ meaning God and ‘Rati’ meaning the beloved or wife of a god. This name is associated with Goddess Durga, the warrior goddess who is the mother of the universe and the wife of Lord Shiva. Debarati represents the divine feminine energy, strength, and devotion.
